cards.text: One day Jesus gets into a boat with His disciples, and they set out on the lake. A boat trip with Jesus? Friend, the farthest I ever traveled was from the counter to the back of a junk drawer, and I didn't even get a WINDOW SEAT. Jesus tells them exactly where they're headed.

cards.question: Jesus and His disciples are setting out in the boat. Where does Jesus say they're going?

answers.text: To the other side of the lake
Back to the town of Capernaum

cards.text: So off they sail across the lake. Somewhere out on the water, Jesus does what plenty of us do when somebody else is steering.

cards.question: As they sail across the lake, Jesus stays awake the whole trip.

cards.text: He falls asleep. Then a windstorm comes down on the lake, the boat starts getting swamped, and they are in GREAT danger.

cards.question: With water filling the boat and Jesus asleep, the disciples go and wake Jesus up.

cards.text: They wake Him: “Master, Master, we are perishing!” No “good morning,” no “sorry to bother You,” they go straight to PERISHING.

cards.question: Woken up in the storm, Jesus gets up and ___ the wind and the raging waters.

cards.text: Jesus rebukes the wind and the raging waters, and they settle down until all is calm, flat as cookie dough under a rolling pin. Then He turns to His disciples, real quiet: “Where is your faith?”

cards.question: Jesus has just calmed the storm and asked the disciples where their faith is. The disciples are ___ and ___.
Frightened and amazed after the storm, the disciples ask one another a question. What do they ask?

cards.text: The disciples can't get over it: even the wind and the water obey Him. Friend, every morning I tell my cookie dough to spread out nice and round, and it STILL comes out shaped however it WANTS.
Jesus and the disciples sail on to the region of the Gerasenes, across the lake from Galilee. When Jesus steps ashore, a demon-possessed man from the town comes to meet Him.

cards.question: For a long time this demon-possessed man hasn't worn clothes or lived in a house. He's been staying in the ___.

cards.text: When the man from the tombs sees Jesus, he cries out and falls down before Him.

cards.question: Lying before Jesus, the man shouts in a loud voice. What does he call Jesus?

answers.text: Son of the Most High God

cards.text: The man shouts, “What do You want with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I beg You not to torture me!”

cards.question: Many times the unclean spirit had seized this man, and when people bound him with chains and shackles, the chains held him.

cards.text: The chains couldn't hold him, but that was no freedom, because the demon drove him off into solitary places. I know a little about being alone in the dark, friend, and this man had it so much worse.
Jesus had already commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. Now He asks, “What is your name?”

cards.question: The man answers Jesus with the name “Legion” because many ___ had gone into him.

cards.text: The demons keep begging Jesus not to order them to go into the Abyss. Meanwhile, on the hillside, a large herd of pigs is feeding.

cards.question: With a herd of pigs feeding on the hillside, the demons beg Jesus for something. What do they ask?

answers.text: To let them enter the pigs
To let them go to the tombs
To let them stay in the town

cards.question: Jesus gives the demons permission to enter the herd of pigs.

cards.text: So the demons come out of the man and go into the pigs.

cards.question: Once the demons go into the herd of pigs, what does the herd do?

answers.text: Rushes into the lake and drowns

cards.text: Those tending the pigs see what happened, and they RUN to report it in the town and countryside. Friend, I've seen people sprint for an oven timer, but nobody moves that fast unless they've got news THIS big.
So the people go out to see what happened, and they come to Jesus. There's the man the demons left, sitting at Jesus' feet.

cards.question: The man who lived in the tombs is now sitting at Jesus' feet, ___ and in his right mind.
When the people find the man clothed and in his right mind at Jesus' feet, they are afraid.

cards.text: Meanwhile, the people who saw it all tell how the demon-possessed man was healed. That's the kind of story that gets around faster than a group chat.

cards.question: Great fear takes hold of all the people of the region of the Gerasenes. What do they ask Jesus to do?

cards.text: So Jesus gets back in the boat to head back, and the man the demons left begs to go with Him. I get it, friend: when Somebody pulls you out of the dark, you don't want to let Him out of your sight.

cards.question: Jesus lets the man the demons left come with Him in the boat.
Jesus sends the man away with a job to do. What is it?

answers.text: Go home and tell what God has done
Wait at the shore for His return
Go and show himself to the priest

cards.text: Jesus tells him, “Return home and describe how much God has done for you.” So the man goes and proclaims all over the town how much Jesus had done for him, and friend, from the tombs to the town square, THAT is a comeback.

findings.problem: The opening card has four sentences: the boat setup, “A boat trip with Jesus?”, the junk-drawer joke, and “Jesus tells them exactly where they're headed.” The opening card is limited to three sentences.

rule.text: The opening card can be up to 3 sentences.

findings.problem: The wrong answer “chained” is true of this same man earlier in the passage: Luke 8:29 says he had been bound with chains and shackles. It is false at the moment when he sits at Jesus' feet, but not false anywhere in the passage.

rule.text: Each wrong answer must be false anywhere in the passage, not just at that moment.
